scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n fe,be -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.format: npm run format:frontend && npm run format:backend
scripts.format:frontend/backend: npm run format:frontend && npm run format:backend
scripts.format-check: npm run format-check:css && npm run format-check:html && npm run format-check:js
scripts.format-check:css/html/js: npm run format-check:css && npm run format-check:html && npm run format-check:js
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css
scripts.lint:js/css: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:css
scripts.validate: npm run format-check:css/html/js && npm run lint:js/css && npm run validate:html && npm run validate:instructions
scripts.init: npm install && cd WarTable.Client && npm install
